actions.detail: Attach to the intended Wix Studio test-site editor tab only.
Capture inspect, element-map, frame-map, diagnostics, save-state, and screenshot before mutations.
Create or select a Wix Studio test site/template matching the business/booking style. CLI must not create paid/live resources silently.
Create/configure page "Premium Stays in Bansko and Sofia" at slug /home; sections: hero, trust, featured-properties, how-it-works, cta
Create/configure page "Available Apartments" at slug /properties; sections: property-grid, filters, cta
Create/configure page "Property Detail" at slug /properties/pirin-golf-studio-velvet; sections: property-hero, gallery, amenities, booking-widget, location, faq

Build section hero: Clear premium booking promise with primary CTA to view apartments and secondary CTA to contact support. with CTA/layout/media requirements.
Build section trust: Show verified properties, professional hosting, guest support, and transparent booking. with CTA/layout/media requirements.
Build section featured-properties: Feature the strongest property cards with image, location, amenities, and booking CTA. with CTA/layout/media requirements.
Build section how-it-works: Explain browse, choose dates, book, and receive check-in support. with CTA/layout/media requirements.
Build section cta: Repeat direct booking/contact CTA. with CTA/layout/media requirements.
Build section property-grid: Scannable apartment cards. with CTA/layout/media requirements.
Build section filters: Location and guest-count filtering when technically available. with CTA/layout/media requirements.
Build section property-hero: Property title, location, hero image, rating/trust markers, booking CTA. with CTA/layout/media requirements.
Build section gallery: Large visual gallery for the apartment. with CTA/layout/media requirements.
Build section amenities: Amenities grouped by comfort, kitchen, parking, internet, and building features. with CTA/layout/media requirements.
Build section booking-widget: Hospitable or equivalent booking iframe/widget in draft/test mode first. with CTA/layout/media requirements.
Build section location: Map/location context and nearby reasons to book. with CTA/layout/media requirements.
Build section faq: Arrival, payment, cancellation, check-in, and support FAQs. with CTA/layout/media requirements.
Build section booking-support: Clarify booking help and fallback contact route. with CTA/layout/media requirements.
Build section contact-form: Simple inquiry form with name, email/phone, dates, and message. with CTA/layout/media requirements.
Build section direct-contact: Phone/email/WhatsApp or approved contact routes. with CTA/layout/media requirements.
Build section map: Location/contact map block. with CTA/layout/media requirements.
Add property card/detail for Pirin Golf Studio Velvet; booking target must remain test/draft unless Alej approves live integration.
Capture desktop/tablet/mobile visual proof and note breakpoints needing manual polish.
Run public/readable SEO proof only against preview/public test URL, not client production.
Emit final proof checklist and remaining unproven gaps before touching real booking website.
